text: Never before in your life have you seen a natural darkness like this one. It almost looks unnatural to you.
source_text:
Never before in your life have you seen a natural darkness like this one.
 It almost looks unnatural to you.

text: You barely manage to keep your fears in check, but you are able to move into the darkness.
